coordinator.name: Coordinator
coordinator.description: Understands the user's goal, routes it to the right specialist, and gathers approvals before any write. It holds no tools itself, so every data change goes through an approval point.

agents.name: Orders agent
agents.description: Handles orders requests with 5 tools; 3 change data and need approval.

agents.name: Health agent
agents.description: Handles health requests with 1 tool, all read-only.

agents.name: Auth agent
agents.description: Handles auth requests with 1 tool; 1 changes data and needs approval.

agents.name: Operations agent
agents.description: Knows the 3 background flow(s) (scheduled jobs, queue consumers, CLI commands) so other agents can explain delayed effects. It has no tools; these flows aren't exposed directly.

multimodal.title: Voice self-service
multimodal.description: Expose the read-only lookups in these flows to a voice agent (phone or assistant), so callers can check status without waiting for staff. Keep writes behind confirmation.

phases.name: Phase 1: Read-only tools
phases.summary: Expose 3 read-only tool(s) through `legacy2mcp generate`. Agents can look things up but change nothing; every call is schema-validated and audit-logged.
prerequisites: Review each tool's description and input schema in the report
Point the generated config at a staging base URL
exit_criteria: Agents answer real questions using only these tools
Audit log reviewed for a week with no surprises

phases.name: Phase 2: Low-risk writes with approval
phases.summary: Add 1 low-risk write tool(s) with `allow_write_operations: true`, each behind a policy approval and rate limits.
prerequisites: Decide the approval policy (who approves, which writes are auto-approved)
exit_criteria: Every write is attributable to an approver in the audit log
Rollback path tested for each write tool

phases.name: Phase 3: Agent orchestration
phases.summary: Run a coordinator with 3 specialist agent(s); add 3 high-risk tool(s) (HTTP DELETE endpoint; changes credentials or issues tokens; deletes orders records) behind human approval on every call, and 1 multimodal intake path(s).
prerequisites: Human-approval UI or chat step wired to the coordinator
Spending/deletion limits agreed with the business owner
Incident runbook for a bad agent action
exit_criteria: High-risk calls happen only after a recorded human approval
End-to-end flows succeed on staging data
